answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment rather than ephemeral identity. An attacker attempting a gale of fake nodes must stake assets, creating a shale of economic barriers that serve as an inlet for cost-based deterrence. This design ensures that the cost of participation scales linearly with network influence, rendering the marginal utility of creating redundant, uncollateralized identities functionally zero for any rational actor.
